description: Source code for an Odoo module implementing idea management with categories, ideas, comments, votes, and vote statistics.

classes.name: idea_category
classes.description: Model representing idea categories with hierarchy and unique name constraint.

classes.name: idea_idea
classes.description: Model representing ideas with voting, commenting, and status management.

classes.name: idea_vote
classes.description: Model for votes on ideas with predefined score values.

classes.name: idea_vote_stat
classes.description: SQL view model for aggregating vote statistics per idea.

methods.name: _vote_avg_compute
methods.description: Computes the average vote score for ideas.

methods.name: _vote_count
methods.description: Counts the number of votes per idea.

methods.name: _comment_count
methods.description: Counts the number of comments per idea.

methods.name: _vote_read
methods.description: Reads the current user's vote for ideas.

methods.name: _vote_save
methods.description: Saves or deletes the current user's vote for an idea.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Creates or replaces the SQL view for vote statistics.
